import.title: Import a calendar
import.description: Add events from another calendar to Sync. Events already in Sync are skipped, and you’ll be asked what to do about schedule conflicts.
import.permissionDescription: Sync needs read access to find events to import.
import.nothingToImport: No upcoming events were found in this period.
import.failed: Could not import events. Try again.
import.phoneDescription: Sync will save upcoming event titles, times, notes, and locations (up to 5 years) from the calendars you choose.
import.icsDescription: A file exported from Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, or any other platform.
import.icsEmpty: No events were found in this file.
import.conflictsDescription: These imported events take the same time slot as an event already in Sync.
import.chooseEachConflict: Choose an option for each conflict

google.title: Google Agenda
google.description: Connect your Google account to import your events into Sync. Sync only reads your calendars: it never changes anything in Google.
google.noAccount: No Google account is connected yet.
google.connectFailed: Could not connect the Google account.
google.misconfigured: Google sign-in is not configured on the server.
google.calendarsDescription: Check the calendars to add to Sync. Uncheck a calendar to remove it from Sync.
google.noCalendars: No calendar is available on this account.
google.saveHint: The import runs in the background: you can leave this screen.
google.loadFailed: Could not load your Google calendars.

month.pickDay: Tap a day to see its events.
